description: Return one AkulaCyber information page as published, in Markdown, with its page URL and the store's telephone, email and contacts page. Use it for questions about delivery cost, payment methods, warranty, returns, the terms of sale, privacy or who runs the store; for ship and delivery dates use akulacyber_estimate_delivery, and for branches or lockers akulacyber_find_delivery_points. Choose topic delivery-and-payment for delivery cost and payment, warranty-and-returns for warranty and returns, public-offer for the terms of sale, privacy-policy for personal data, about for the seller; lang picks the language version of the page.

lang.description: Language of the texts and page URLs in the answer: uk (Ukrainian, the default), ru (Russian) or en (English). Use the language the user writes in.

topic.description: delivery-and-payment: delivery methods and cost, same-day cut-off, payment methods and bank details; warranty-and-returns; public-offer: the terms of sale; privacy-policy; about: the seller and contacts.

name: akulacyber_get_store_policy
title: Get AkulaCyber store terms
